//: The from -> to map. This is the ONLY file holding a naming decision; everything else in migration/ is name-agnostic.
//phases: apply.mjs runs ONE phase at a time. A package mapped to null is not in scope for the current phase and is left completely untouched.
//packages: PHASE 1. An explicit per-package map, NOT a scope swap: @ts-runtypes/core cannot become @mionjs/core because the mion framework already owns that name. devtools and bin stay put on purpose -- they are being folded into @mionjs/devtools as subpaths in a later phase, so renaming them now would rename them twice.
//later: Filled in when their phase arrives. apply.mjs throws rather than write a half-formed name while a needed target is still empty.
//dirs: PHASE 2. Package DIRECTORIES only; the bare tool name is `toolName`, deferred to the brand phase. Same null-means-later rule as `packages`: devtools and bin fold into packages/devtools in phase 4, so moving their directories now would move them twice.
//tools: PHASE 3b. The bare tool name: the CLI users type, the tsconfig plugin key and the node_modules/.cache directory. The three sibling package names wait for phase 4.
